title: The Syndicate Truce
logline: Two warring factions are trying to negotiate a ceasefire, but a third party is paying a bounty hunter to ensure the war continues.

roles.description: Cold, professional, only cares about the payout.
Idealistic but exhausted, risking everything for peace.
A neutral zone where the talks are being held.
One side of the brutal gang war.
A heavily armed ship hired to disrupt the peace.

public_situation: A historic truce is being negotiated between two massive criminal enterprises.
private_truth: The weapons suppliers for both sides have hired mercenaries to assassinate the envoys and keep the profitable war going.

beats.public_change: The peace envoys arrive at the neutral station under heavy guard.

missions.reason: Needs a pilot to intercept a suspected assassin ship and recover their encrypted orders.
missions.private_fact: The envoy suspects someone in their own syndicate is trying to kill them.

beats.public_change: An explosion rocks the neutral station, though the envoys survive.

missions.reason: The hunter is hired to finish off the remaining mercenaries before they talk.
missions.private_fact: The mercenary captain is actually aboard the target ship and makes a desperate offer to pay double if spared.

missions.reason: Needs the original signed treaty document moved to a secure vault immediately.
missions.private_fact: If the treaty is destroyed before archiving, the war resumes automatically.

resolutions.summary: The treaty is ratified. The war ends, bringing a tense peace to the sector.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the mercenary's offer.
resolutions.summary: The weapons suppliers are exposed. The syndicates unite against their former backers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the treaty or fails to recover the orders.
resolutions.summary: The talks collapse in a bloodbath. The syndicate war resumes with unprecedented violence.

loose_threads.detail: The mercenaries were paid with uncirculated bullion from a closed treasury reserve.
The bomb casing matches civilian mining charges, not high-end corporate ordnance.

radio_hooks: Factions agree to historic talks at neutral station.
Reports of mercenary activity threaten fragile ceasefire.

voice_direction.bounty_hunter: Flat, emotionless, speaks in exact credits and timelines.
voice_direction.peace_envoy: Weary, diplomatic, constantly trying to de-escalate.
